blocks.text: Before any data moves, your browser and the server agree on secret keys.

Browser says hello
Server shows its certificate
They agree on a session key
Every request and reply is now encrypted with that session key.
A certificate authority your browser already trusts has vouched for the server.

narration.1: First comes the handshake. Your browser and the server agree on secret keys before anything else moves.
narration.2: From then on, every request and every reply is sealed with that session key.
narration.3: But why believe the server is who it says it is? Because someone your browser already trusts has vouched for it.
